prompt.text:
Implement `createChoiceModel(options)`. `options` must be a nonempty array of distinct, nonempty strings; otherwise throw `TypeError`. Copy the array so later caller mutation has no effect. The returned object must expose `select(value)`, `current()`, and `message()`. Initially, `current()` returns `null` and `message()` returns `Nothing chosen`. `select` changes the current choice and returns `true` only when `value` exactly matches an available option. For any other value it returns `false` without changing the current choice. After selection, `message()` returns `Chosen: ` followed by the choice. Export exactly `{ createChoiceModel }` using CommonJS.
